artifacts.summary: Confirms the plan-compliance spot-check's grep scope (find_decl_files/find_field_files, and the replacement_targets sweep that reuses them) must union lean-src-roots.sh's resolved roots with the plan's own harvested Files-to-modify list and the Challenge snapshot manifest's challenge_path, entirely within lean-plan-compliance-check.sh; no change needed to lean-implementation-agent.md's step 5 call site, step 0, or steps 1-4. Recommends reusing the existing core-extension plan-file-scope-harvest.sh rather than a new parser, flags a territory overlap with concurrent sibling task #504 on the same two files, and flags an adjacent but out-of-scope blind spot in step 6's comparator-gate Preflight 4.

memory_candidates.content: lean-plan-compliance-check.sh's per-name declaration/field lookup (find_decl_files, find_field_files) greps only the lean-src-roots.sh-resolved roots passed in as CLI args, which misses this repo's evidence-probe convention (Goals pinned in specs/evidence/**/*.lean). The fix is to widen only those two functions (not find_module_files, which is directory-rooted) to also search the plan's own harvested Files-to-modify list (reuse agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, already deployed at .claude/scripts/plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, rather than re-parsing) plus the Challenge snapshot manifest's project_root+challenge_path join, derivable entirely from the plan_file argument the script already receives -- no caller-side change needed.

The lean extension already declares a dependency on the core extension (manifest.json) and already calls core-extension scripts directly from lean agent/script files (e.g. .claude/scripts/git-commit-scoped.sh from lean agent files). A new cross-extension call from a lean-extension script into another core-extension script (e.g. plan-file-scope-harvest.sh) is therefore precedented and architecturally unremarkable, not a new seam requiring manifest changes.
